targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, count(*) AS requests FROM chat_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, percentile_cont(.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM chat_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, count(*) AS errors FROM chat_events WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, hit_rate FROM evaluation_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, mrr FROM evaluation_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1
SELECT CASE rating WHEN 1 THEN 'Helpful' ELSE 'Not helpful' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM feedback GROUP BY rating
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, sum(token_estimate) AS tokens FROM chat_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
